clean.text: Nothing required attention on these: 1099 Rolando Flores (H2S daily for Ovintiv H&P 395, all photos on date, all compliance answers Yes, hydro and cascade fields correctly exempt); 1099 Robert Henigan (air job 35929 on Shaq B plus Trailer Readiness Forms for trailers 602 and 175, all photos on date, all cascade entries complete); Larry Taylor (field service job 35900 with the work described and all photos on date); Dennis Easley (supervision close-out 35240_2, thirteen daily entries all consistent); Kyle Williams (Commuting Journey Management Plan complete, all fields answered); Bobby Fleming's and Justin Pack's hydro and cascade entries were clean, and Jeremy Norris's trailer 601 inspection and readiness forms were clean apart from the one blank noted above.

Both trailer forms and the equipment sections of the H2S daily are photo-based, so a defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text fields, so this review can confirm that a photo was taken and when it was taken but not what it shows. That is why the stale fire extinguisher tag photo on trailer 602 and the stale truck ball photo on trailer 604 are listed as documentation items rather than as confirmed equipment problems.

One further limitation specific to this run: the review ran at 11:00 PM Central, before the day was over. Submissions for Sunday that land in the mailbox overnight or tomorrow morning are not included and would not have been visible to this search. Any late-arriving form will be picked up and attributed to 10/18 in tomorrow's review.
